nodes.notes:
Pass-through start. Provide one item per pose or upstream item explosion.
Expected fields per item:
 - characterSpecs (object)
 - hairPromptMeta (optional)
 - characterHash (string)
 - poseNumber (int 1..12) OR names we can parse to get poseNumber
 - binary.character OR json.characterBase64 (IMAGE A)
Optional: binary.hair (IMAGE B), binary.skin (IMAGE C)
